boundary: All tasks are unstarted templates. No task is field-verified and no task authorizes booking, payment or a supplier claim.

tasks.object: People's Square museum and civic-core route
tasks.method: complete walk + timed museum entry check
tasks.why: Determines whether a first-time English visitor can start with one cultural frame without hidden entry friction.
tasks.pass_criteria: A foreign visitor can identify the correct entrance, understand the basic rules and complete the planned museum segment without invented access assumptions.
tasks.blocking_condition: No reliable foreign-visitor entry path, unresolved identity rule or no workable rainy-day exit.

tasks.method: complete route at normal pace and blue-hour recheck
tasks.why: Determines whether the river contrast can be experienced without a generic viewpoint checklist.
tasks.pass_criteria: The route has one readable river question, one lower-friction fallback and a safe return path.
tasks.blocking_condition: Crossing depends on an unconfirmed service, unsafe crowd edge or an itinerary that cannot protect recovery time.

tasks.method: complete walk on weekday and inspect wet-weather cover
tasks.why: Determines whether the architecture route is walkable and respectful of residents.
tasks.pass_criteria: The route can be explained as public-street observation without entering private compounds or staging local life.
tasks.blocking_condition: No practical rest/exit plan, unsafe crossings or unclear privacy boundary.

tasks.object: Yangpu or West Bund public-space route
tasks.method: start-to-end continuity walk with evening-light check
tasks.why: Determines whether a regeneration story works as a route rather than a collection of disconnected places.
tasks.pass_criteria: A guest can complete a bounded segment and leave safely if the far end or programme is unavailable.
tasks.blocking_condition: Broken continuity or night exit makes the route fragile.

tasks.object: 解放碑—魁星楼—洪崖洞外观—大剧院江岸
tasks.method: day complete walk + weekend night rewalk
tasks.why: Validates the core multi-level and night-visual route without requiring a full commercial-complex visit.
tasks.pass_criteria: High, medium and lower-load variants can be described with clear exits and no private-space dependency.
tasks.blocking_condition: A key connection depends on temporary passage, unsafe edge or unresolved construction.
cannot_promote_to: 特定灯光/无人机秀保证

tasks.object: 朝天门江岸与两江方向
tasks.why: Validates the city-gateway explanation and a lower-friction river-edge entry.
tasks.pass_criteria: Ordinary-weather and adverse-weather versions both have clear arrival and exit logic.
tasks.blocking_condition: River edge is closed or the only route is high-load and exposed.

tasks.object: 湖广会馆—东水门—白象街
tasks.why: Validates the migration, trade and ordinary-life explanation layer.
tasks.pass_criteria: Public access, English explanation scope and route continuity are independently evidenced.
tasks.blocking_condition: English/access cannot be confirmed or the route requires an unstable passage.

tasks.object: 轨道 2 号线乘车—李子坝
tasks.why: Makes the train ride—not the viewpoint—the core explanation of Chongqing's transport system.
tasks.pass_criteria: The experience works without promising a specific train or forcing a dangerous platform stop.
tasks.blocking_condition: Construction or crowding removes the safe observation point.

tasks.object: 世界遗产公共访问与外籍游客预约路径
tasks.why: Determines whether the maritime-system route can be used by a foreign visitor without guessing payment, identity or reservation steps.
tasks.pass_criteria: Public heritage access can be described with a reproducible foreign-visitor path.
tasks.blocking_condition: No reliable channel or unresolved identity/payment barrier.

tasks.object: 德化陶瓷公共体验线索
tasks.why: Separates a publicly released ceramics activity from an assumed private factory or artist visit.
tasks.pass_criteria: Only the explicitly released public activity is described; all private access is removed.
tasks.blocking_condition: Venue cannot confirm responsibility, capacity, price or filming boundary.

tasks.object: 到达、道路、住宿、支付和通讯
tasks.why: A deep tea-forest product fails if recovery, payment or emergency communication is not workable.
tasks.pass_criteria: The route has a realistic arrival/departure buffer and a documented fallback for weather or road disruption.
tasks.blocking_condition: No safe arrival window, unreliable accommodation or no practical emergency fallback.

tasks.object: 公共茶林步行与社区同意边界
tasks.why: Ensures the tea-forest story is about landscape and livelihoods without turning residents into staged attractions.
tasks.pass_criteria: The route stays in public/consented space and can be shortened safely when weather or body capacity changes.
tasks.blocking_condition: No clear consent, unsafe footing or pressure to arrange private homes/rituals.
